description: Create a personalized week-by-week study plan for a student from their syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what they need to study. Requires the student’s email (the plan is sent/saved to it). Returns the plan summary and a shareable link. Free. Use it when a student asks for help planning their studying or exam prep.

email.description: The student’s email address (required — the study plan is saved to it).

syllabus.description: The syllabus, exam topics, or a description of what to study (at least ~10 characters).
examples: Biology exam: cell division, genetics, evolution

name: generate_study_plan
title: Generate a personalized study plan
